chapters.label: Prologue
chapters.title: The knot at the Dawn Door

panels.line: Long ago, the Dawn Door at the top of the Tower of Worlds opened every morning, and light flowed down through all seventeen worlds.
panels.alt: The Tower of Worlds at sunrise, light pouring from the open Dawn Door down every tier.

panels.line: Then one night the Duskweaver sealed the door with a knot of shadow, and tangled every path below with his arrows.
panels.alt: The Duskweaver, a great moth with indigo wings, ties a knot of violet thread across the Dawn Door.

panels.line: At the tower's foot, Prince Arlo drew his bow. "Every arrow has a way out," he said. "I'll find them all."
panels.alt: Prince Arlo, a knight archer with a golden longbow, faces a tangle of arrows at the foot of the tower.

panels.line: Pip the owl flew down to join him, carrying a lantern that held the last spark of dawn.
panels.alt: Pip, a small sleek owl, glides down beside the prince with a glowing lantern.

panels.line: In the Meadow, Bramble the hedgehog lay curled in violet thorns, his spines bristling with cursed arrows.
panels.alt: Bramble, a huge hedgehog wrapped in violet thorns, with glowing eyes and arrows stuck in his spines.

pages.lockedLine: Free the Meadow to read on

panels.line: With the last arrow, the curse on Bramble snapped like an old thread, and flowers burst from his spines.
panels.alt: The violet thorns snap away from Bramble as flowers bloom across his spines.

panels.line: One by one the stepping stones lit up, climbing toward the jungle above.
panels.alt: Glowing stepping stones climb from the Meadow up toward the Jungle tier.

panels.line: "Mossback guards the jungle," Bramble warned. "And he never lowers his shield."
panels.alt: Bramble, freed and friendly, points the prince up the path.

pages.lockedLine: Free the Meadow to unlock

panels.line: The jungle was silent under the dusk. High on a vine-wrapped rock, Mossback raised a shield of solid stone.
panels.alt: Mossback, a mighty gorilla with a stone shield, on a vine-covered rock in the dusky jungle.

panels.line: "Watch the shield," Pip whispered. "It moves after every few hits. Strike where it isn't."
panels.alt: Pip whispers to the prince behind giant leaves while Mossback looms above.

pages.lockedLine: Free the Jungle to read on

panels.line: Arlo's arrows found every gap. The stone shield cracked, and Mossback's eyes cleared from violet to green.
panels.alt: Mossback's stone shield cracks apart and his eyes turn from violet to green.

panels.line: The gorilla bowed low and lifted the prince onto the next stones, toward a red glow in the sky.
panels.alt: Mossback lifts the prince onto glowing stepping stones under a red sky.

panels.line: "The volcano burns with a cursed fire," Mossback rumbled. "Only arrows of its colour will pass."
panels.alt: Mossback points up toward the smoking volcano on the next tier.

pages.lockedLine: Free the Jungle to unlock

panels.line: Ash fell like snow on the Volcano. Cinder the lava dragon coiled around the crater, guarding it with a wall of fire.
panels.alt: Cinder, a lava dragon, coils around a glowing crater behind a wall of one-coloured fire.

panels.line: The fire burned in a single colour. Arlo nocked an arrow of the same colour. "Then I'll answer it in kind."
panels.alt: The prince nocks a glowing arrow the same colour as the fire wall.

pages.lockedLine: Free the Volcano to read on

panels.line: The last arrow flew through the flames in their own colour, and the curse on Cinder hissed out like steam.
panels.alt: The curse leaves Cinder in a burst of steam as the fire wall fades.

panels.line: Freed, the dragon spread her wings over the lava and cooled a bridge of black stone for the prince.
panels.alt: Cinder spreads her wings over a river of lava, cooling it into a stone bridge.

panels.line: Beyond it, the Desert shimmered gold, and something huge rolled across the dunes.
panels.alt: Golden dunes on the next tier, with a giant shining shape rolling across them.

pages.lockedLine: Free the Volcano to unlock

panels.line: In the Desert, Rollo the sun scarab pushed a cursed sun across the sand, a shield that swept from side to side.
panels.alt: Rollo, a giant golden scarab, pushes a dark cursed sun across the dunes.

panels.line: "Left, middle, right," Arlo counted, watching it roll. "And then the gap opens."
panels.alt: The prince crouches on a dune, counting as the sun shield sweeps past.

pages.lockedLine: Free the Desert to read on

panels.line: The sun shield shattered into sparks, and Rollo's shell shone like polished gold again.
panels.alt: The cursed sun bursts into sparks and Rollo's shell gleams gold.

panels.line: The scarab rolled the stepping stones back into place, and cool spray drifted down from the Lagoon above.
panels.alt: Rollo pushes glowing stones into a path that climbs toward a misty lagoon.

pages.lockedLine: Free the Desert to unlock

panels.line: The Lagoon lay frozen in the dusk. Old Shellby the sea turtle drifted beneath the ice, the curse heavy on his shell.
panels.alt: Shellby, a huge sea turtle, drifts under a frozen lagoon with violet thorns on his shell.

panels.line: When he stirred, frost spread across the water. "His spells freeze the path," Pip warned. "Keep moving."
panels.alt: Frost spreads over the water toward the prince's boots as Pip lifts the lantern.

pages.lockedLine: Free the Lagoon to read on

panels.line: The ice cracked from shore to shore as the curse let go, and Shellby rose blinking into the light.
panels.alt: The ice breaks apart as Shellby surfaces into warm light.

panels.line: The turtle carried Arlo and Pip across the water to stepping stones of glowing mushroom caps.
panels.alt: The prince and Pip ride on Shellby's back toward glowing mushroom stepping stones.

pages.lockedLine: Free the Lagoon to unlock

panels.line: Spores glowed violet in the Mushroom forest. Puffcap the toad sat on the tallest cap, puffing out a cursed shield.
panels.alt: Puffcap, a great toad, swells up on a giant mushroom behind a violet shield.

panels.line: "He gets quicker when he's hurt," Pip said. "His shield will jump sooner. Be ready."
panels.alt: Pip perches on the prince's bow among glowing spores.

pages.lockedLine: Free the Mushroom forest to read on

panels.line: With a great croak, Puffcap's curse burst like a bubble, and the spores turned soft and golden.
panels.alt: The curse pops off Puffcap like a bubble and golden spores float up.

panels.line: The toad took one mighty leap and landed on the path to the Autumn woods, where the leaves had stopped falling.
panels.alt: Puffcap lands on the stepping stones below a forest of frozen autumn leaves.

pages.lockedLine: Free the Mushroom forest to unlock

panels.line: In the Autumn woods, Oakheart the great stag stood between the trees, a one-colour shield woven through his antlers.
panels.alt: Oakheart, a great stag, with a glowing one-coloured shield woven through his antlers.

panels.line: Arlo dipped his arrows in the colours of the fallen leaves. "If the shield wants a colour, I'll paint one."
panels.alt: The prince dips arrowheads in pools of red, orange and gold leaf colour.

pages.lockedLine: Free the Autumn woods to read on

panels.line: The painted arrows slipped through, and the curse fell from Oakheart's antlers like dry leaves.
panels.alt: Violet threads fall from Oakheart's antlers like dry leaves.

panels.line: The stag lowered his head, and the woods blazed red and gold as the leaves began to fall again.
panels.alt: Oakheart bows as red and gold leaves swirl through the woods.

panels.line: "Up there it's colder than any winter," Oakheart said. "Frostbeard has not moved in a hundred dusks."
panels.alt: Oakheart looks up at an icy glacier on the next tier.

pages.lockedLine: Free the Autumn woods to unlock

panels.line: Wind howled across the Glacier. Frostbeard the yeti rose from the snow, half his body hidden behind a wall of ice.
panels.alt: Frostbeard, a towering yeti, rises from the snow behind a wall of ice.

panels.line: He roared, and frost crept over the arrows. Arlo pulled his cape tight and drew his bow.
panels.alt: Frost creeps over a tangle of arrows as the prince draws his bow in the blizzard.

pages.lockedLine: Free the Glacier to read on

panels.line: The ice wall split down the middle, and the curse melted from Frostbeard's beard in a cloud of steam.
panels.alt: The ice wall splits and steam rises from Frostbeard's beard.

panels.line: The yeti laughed like thunder and kicked open a tunnel into the mountain, where crystals glittered in the dark.
panels.alt: Frostbeard kicks open an icy tunnel full of glittering crystals.

pages.lockedLine: Free the Glacier to unlock

panels.line: Deep in the Crystal caves, Prism the crystal golem woke with a grinding of stone and light.
panels.alt: Prism, a golem of crystal and stone, wakes in a dark cave.

panels.line: His shield shone in two colours, and stone shutters slammed across the tunnels. "Two locks," Arlo said. "Two keys."
panels.alt: A two-coloured crystal shield and stone shutters slamming across cave tunnels.

pages.lockedLine: Free the Crystal caves to read on

panels.line: The last arrow rang against the crystal like a bell, and the curse inside Prism shattered into rainbows.
panels.alt: Rainbow light bursts out of Prism as the curse shatters.

panels.line: Light poured through the caves for the first time in ages, and the path climbed out into pink blossoms.
panels.alt: Light floods the caves and stepping stones lead out into cherry blossoms.

pages.lockedLine: Free the Crystal caves to unlock

panels.line: Petals hung frozen in the air of the Cherry blossom world. Petalwing the crane spread her wings across the sky.
panels.alt: Petalwing, a great crane, spreads cursed wings over frozen cherry petals.

panels.line: Her wings covered almost everything, leaving one narrow gap that drifted with the wind.
panels.alt: A single narrow gap of sky between the crane's huge wings.

pages.lockedLine: Free the Cherry blossom to read on

panels.line: Arlo threaded the gap again and again, until the curse slid from Petalwing's feathers.
panels.alt: An arrow flies through the gap and the violet curse slides off the crane's feathers.

panels.line: The petals fell at last, and the crane danced. Above, a town of gears had stopped ticking.
panels.alt: Petalwing dances in falling petals below a silent clockwork town.

pages.lockedLine: Free the Cherry blossom to unlock

panels.line: Every clock in Clockwork town had stopped at dusk. Only Sir Sprocket still marched, his gear shield sweeping the square.
panels.alt: Sir Sprocket, a clockwork knight, marches with a sweeping gear shield in a silent town square.

panels.line: "Look for the switches," Pip said. "Every machine has a way to open it."
panels.alt: Pip lights up a brass switch on a wall of gears.

pages.lockedLine: Free Clockwork town to read on

panels.line: Click. Clack. The last switch turned, the last arrow struck, and Sir Sprocket's curse wound down to silence.
panels.alt: The gear shield winds down and violet threads fall from Sir Sprocket.

panels.line: Then every clock in town chimed at once, and the knight saluted the prince with a whirr of gears.
panels.alt: Sir Sprocket salutes the prince as every clock tower chimes.

panels.line: Up the next stones, waves rolled over a reef, and a cloud of ink was spreading through the water.
panels.alt: A coral reef on the next tier, darkened by a spreading cloud of ink.

pages.lockedLine: Free Clockwork town to unlock

panels.line: On the Coral reef, Inkwell the octopus wrapped eight cursed arms around the rocks and blotted out the light with ink.
panels.alt: Inkwell, a giant octopus, wraps the reef in cursed arms and clouds of ink.

panels.line: Clouds of ink swallowed the paths. "They clear again," Pip said, lifting the lantern. "Count your shots."
panels.alt: Pip's lantern glows through a cloud of ink over the reef.

pages.lockedLine: Free the Coral reef to read on

panels.line: The curse washed out of Inkwell like ink in the tide, and the reef glowed in every colour.
panels.alt: The ink washes away and the reef glows in bright colours around Inkwell.

panels.line: The octopus waved all eight arms in thanks as Arlo climbed toward the misty Bayou.
panels.alt: Inkwell waves eight arms as the prince climbs toward a misty swamp.

pages.lockedLine: Free the Coral reef to unlock

panels.line: The fireflies had gone dark over the Bayou. Snapjaw the alligator rose from the swamp, jaws open wide.
panels.alt: Snapjaw, a huge alligator, rises from a dark swamp with his jaws open.

panels.line: His two shields closed in from both sides like teeth. "Shoot fast," Arlo said, "before they bite."
panels.alt: Two shields close in from left and right like the jaws of an alligator.

pages.lockedLine: Free the Bayou to read on

panels.line: The jaws snapped shut on nothing, and the curse sank from Snapjaw into the black water.
panels.alt: The curse sinks away from Snapjaw into the swamp water.

panels.line: The fireflies lit up one by one, and the path ahead smelled suddenly of sugar.
panels.alt: Fireflies light up a path of stepping stones toward a candy-coloured tier.

pages.lockedLine: Free the Bayou to unlock

panels.line: Candy land had gone sour. Gumdrop the gummy knight stood guard, his shield changing colour every time it moved.
panels.alt: Gumdrop, a gummy knight, guards a sour candy land with a colour-changing shield.

panels.line: "Watch the colour, not the knight," Pip said. "It never stays the same for long."
panels.alt: Pip watches the shield flash from one colour to the next.

pages.lockedLine: Free Candy land to read on

panels.line: The shield wobbled, glowed and burst, and Gumdrop's curse melted like sugar in the rain.
panels.alt: Gumdrop's shield bursts and the curse melts away like sugar.

panels.line: Candy land turned sweet again, and the stones led up to ancient ruins wrapped in silence.
panels.alt: Bright candy hills below silent stone temple ruins.

pages.lockedLine: Free Candy land to unlock

panels.line: In the Temple ruins, the Stone Sentinel woke. Two great stone hands rose from the floor to guard its face.
panels.alt: The Stone Sentinel, an ancient statue, raises two giant stone hands in the ruins.

panels.line: The hands moved like a slow puzzle, one shielding as the other opened. Arlo studied them, arrow ready.
panels.alt: The prince studies the two stone hands, arrow on the string.

pages.lockedLine: Free the Temple ruins to read on

panels.line: The last arrow found the gap between the hands, and the curse crumbled from the Sentinel like old dust.
panels.alt: The curse crumbles off the Stone Sentinel like dust.

panels.line: The Sentinel lowered its hands and pointed to the sky, where islands floated in a sea of storm clouds.
panels.alt: The Sentinel points up at islands floating among storm clouds.

pages.lockedLine: Free the Temple ruins to unlock

panels.line: Lightning cracked between the Sky islands. Stormwing the thunder griffin circled, his shield flashing from place to place.
panels.alt: Stormwing, a thunder griffin, circles the sky islands in a lightning storm.

panels.line: "He never holds still," Pip shouted over the wind. "Two hits, and he moves again!"
panels.alt: Pip clings to the prince's cape in the wind as lightning flashes.

pages.lockedLine: Free the Sky islands to read on

panels.line: With a final thunderclap, the curse burst from Stormwing's feathers, and the storm rolled away.
panels.alt: The curse bursts from Stormwing and the storm clouds roll away.

panels.line: The griffin carried Arlo and Pip up through the clouds to the last world, where the stars hung close.
panels.alt: The prince and Pip ride Stormwing up into a starry sky.

panels.line: At the very top stood the Dawn Door, still knotted shut. And before it waited the Duskweaver.
panels.alt: The knotted Dawn Door at the summit, with the Duskweaver's silhouette before it.

pages.lockedLine: Free the Sky islands to unlock

panels.line: In Starlight, the Duskweaver spread his indigo wings across the sky, and every star dimmed.
panels.alt: The Duskweaver spreads star-dusted indigo wings and the stars dim.

panels.line: "You freed my guardians," he said. "But the door is mine. Every knot I tied, I tied twice."
panels.alt: The Duskweaver's lantern-yellow eyes glare down at the prince.

pages.lockedLine: Free Starlight to read on

panels.line: Arrow after arrow, Arlo cut through knot, shield and spell, until a single thread still held the door.
panels.alt: The prince looses an arrow at the last violet thread across the Dawn Door.

panels.line: Then it broke. The Duskweaver sank to his knees as his violet threads unravelled into the night.
panels.alt: The Duskweaver kneels as his violet threads unravel.

pages.lockedLine: Open the Dawn Door to unlock

panels.line: The Dawn Door swung open, and morning poured down the tower, through every world, from Starlight to the Meadow.
panels.alt: The Dawn Door opens and golden light floods down every tier of the tower.

panels.line: Pip flew to the Duskweaver with a small lantern of his own. "The night needs light too," Pip said.
panels.alt: Pip offers the Duskweaver a small glowing lantern.

panels.line: So the Duskweaver became the tower's night-keeper, and every evening he lights the stars, one by one.
panels.alt: The Duskweaver lights the stars above the tower at dusk.

pages.lockedLine: Open the Dawn Door to unlock

panels.line: But curses leave echoes. Some nights, the shadows of old guardians return, and Prince Arlo takes up his bow again.
panels.alt: Shadowy echoes of the guardians under a night sky as the prince raises his bow.
